entities.summary: Vladimir Andreyevich Musalimov was a Soviet amateur welterweight boxer. He won bronze medals at the 1968 Olympics and 1969 European Championships and a silver medal at the 1971 World Army Championships. Musalimov was the Soviet champion in 1967–69.
